note: M46 (D-084): the LGPL libraries of the Windows runtime, as checked by tools/m46_lgpl.py. Each is its own DLL in bin/ that rexruntime.dll imports by name (LGPL-2.1 section 6(b)); no other shipped binary contains their code. The corresponding source archive is built by 'tools/m46_lgpl.py package' and must be distributed with the program from the same place. Human-readable form: tools/installer/LGPL-SOURCE.txt (staged as app/licenses/LGPL-SOURCE.txt). Technical record only, NOT a legal clearance.

ffmpeg.contains: FFmpeg libavutil + libavcodec (static archives of the SDK's own source lists, linked into one DLL; exports: every av* symbol, as upstream libavutil.v / libavcodec.v)
ffmpeg.base: FFmpeg 4.4 (RELEASE file) with the Xenia XMA 'xmaframes' decoder
ffmpeg.local_patches: none: the submodule is clean at the pin; the build adds only the SDK's ffmpeg-overlay lists and the M46 DLL files

compiled_sources_without_lgpl_header.libavutil/adler32.c: zlib-style permissive notice in the file
compiled_sources_without_lgpl_header.libavutil/avsscanf.c: musl, MIT notice in the file
compiled_sources_without_lgpl_header.libavcodec/jfdctfst.c: Independent JPEG Group notice in the file
compiled_sources_without_lgpl_header.libavcodec/jrevdct.c: Independent JPEG Group notice in the file

libmspack.contains: libmspack lzxd.c (the LZX decompressor; exports lzxd_*)
libmspack.local_patches: none: lzxd.c and its headers equal libmspack/mspack/* at the pin; the SDK builds them through cabextract/mspack, whose git symlinks are file copies on Windows (E-06)
markers: invalid reset interval detected during LZX decompression
